title: Learning consequences coordinate coefficient
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $Q$, define the coordinate coefficient by $128(Q+1)^2(C+1)^3 + 4K(C,Q) + 5$, where $K(C,Q)$ is the degree coefficient used in the learning consequences bound.
caveat: The defining expression refers to `learningConsequencesDegreeCoefficient`, but its definition is not included in the supplied context, so its meaning cannot be stated self-containedly.
